decisions.reason: This product is close to the core offer, has been publicly maintained on its own page for two years, and already shows visible external adoption, so management is strongly inclined to continue rather than admit a failed commitment.

Although its results are not quantified, the firm has kept promoting it as a standalone offer and it fits the announced strategy of extending security-related digital services, which under escalation logic supports continued backing despite some uncertainty.

The web platform remains clearly marketed, is close to the firm's established operational capabilities, and supports integrated security and compliance services, so a growing firm is more likely to retain it than to write off the investment.
